data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (From/To, trip type and dates, optional points, Search flights, the Continue modal, then Sort & Filter, sort and Apply) and names nearly all the parameters. It makes the sort too price-specific, it does not name payment type and sort_option as clearly as the true spec, and it adds optional extras (Details, a Dollars/Points toggle), so the spec is slightly vague but still automatable.
